# Kestrel

> Documentation for an invented data-sync tool. Kestrel does not exist and
> cannot be downloaded; these pages are here so Braille AI can watch how AI
> crawlers read a documentation site.

## Start here
- [Install Kestrel](https://kestrel-docs.netlify.app/start/install)
- [Your first sync](https://kestrel-docs.netlify.app/start/first-sync)
- [Configuration file](https://kestrel-docs.netlify.app/start/configuration)
- [Upgrading](https://kestrel-docs.netlify.app/start/upgrading)

- [kestrel (command line)](https://kestrel-docs.netlify.app/reference/cli)
